results.Summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Solera, 2023-2025 Forester, and Sunseeker motorhomes.  The Liquid Propane (LP) line may not be properly secured, which can cause the line to become damaged and leak.
results.Consequence: A propane gas leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Dealers will install a p-clamp to secure the LP line, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed May 28, 2024.  Owners may contact Forest River Customer Service at 1-574-206-7600.  Forest River's number for this recall is 34-1780.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

results.Component: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
results.Summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Sunseeker, Solera, Forester, Freelander, Leprechaun, and East to West Entrada motorhomes. The fuel line extension connectors  may have inconsistent crimps, allowing the fuel line to detach.
results.Consequence: A detached fuel line can leak, increasing the risk of a fire.
results.Remedy: Dealers will inspect and replace the fuel lines as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed beginning September 26, 2025. Entrada owners may contact customer service at 1-574-264-6664. Forester, Solera, and Sunseeker owners may contact customer service at 1-574-206-7600. Leprechaun and Freelander owners may contact customer service at 1-574-825-8602. Forest River's number for this recall is 51-1955.
